name: UPAVAN
description: With the efforts to recreate the ethos and spirit of Bengaluru, living amongst the huge gulmohars, jacarandas and the rain trees, we envision Upavan to be a residential gated community living in close connections to nature. The key concept was to build a Forest Garden (Upavan) that brims life in a cycle of mindful living, preserving and nurturing. Upavan ensures a lifestyle that is not just within
address: Icon Layout, Sy 7/11 and 7/12, , Hoshalli, Hennagara Road, Jigani Hobli , Anekal , Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka - 560099
